sql: /* Query 4: 2 (team) */ SELECT championship, founded_year, location FROM team WHERE location = 'Brooklyn' AND location = 'Memphis'

championship.description: championships is the number of this team getting championships (e.g. 5).

founded_year.description: founded_year is the year of this team team founded (e.g. 1947).

location.description: location is the lastest city the team team located (e.g. Los Angeles).
